Theorem
[dependence of commuting fields in positive curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0337, petersen:page-0338 ↗ def:pet-ch8-killing-field ↗ prop:pet-ch8-killing-curvature-identities 1. ch8:8.3.5Let $M$ be a compact $n$-manifold with positive sectional curvature. Two commuting Killing fields must be linearly dependent somewhere on $M$.
Proof

↗ thm:pet-ch8-grove-searle-commuting-dependent \sketch For commuting $X,Y$, section 1 reduces the curvature identity to

\[ R(X,Y,Y,X)=-g( abla _XX, abla _YY)+| abla _XY|^2. \]

If $Y$ never vanishes, consider the squared norm of the component of $X$ orthogonal to $Y$,

\[ f= rac12\left(|X|^2- rac{g(X,Y)^2}{|Y|^2} ight). \]

Were $f>0$, at a minimum one may replace $X$ by $X-aY$ so that $X\perp Y$. The norm Hessian formula from section 2, the displayed curvature identity, and skew-adjointness of both covariant derivatives produce a direction in which $\operatorname {Hess}f<0$, contradicting minimality. Thus $f=0$ somewhere, exactly where $X,Y$ are dependent.

□
